curation.notes: No optical trap is used: a 3009 bp dsDNA entropic spring ('DNA tensiometer') links SNAP-tagged kinesin-1, Kif3A (kinesin-2) and Kif1A (kinesin-3) chimeras to biotinylated microtubules via neutravidin, and Qdot-labeled motors are tracked by custom TIRF to measure stall/detachment and reattachment kinetics under load parallel to the microtubule. The 0.05 pN/nm trap stiffness in the auto record is a literature comparison value; stochastic simulations complement the experiments.

evidence.snippet: Raw data were typically collected at 25 fps (range of 20–40 fps) on a Photometrics Prime 95B camera.
